trigger: Pay by invoice request, to the customer (billing.js requestNet30)
subject: We got your request to pay by invoice
preheader: We'll review it and reply by email.
footer_note: You're getting this because you have a VF Tech plan. Billing emails like this one can't be turned off.
body: We got your request to pay your {{plan}} plan by invoice, due 30 days after it's sent. We'll review it and reply by email. Once it's set up, your account page shows it.
